Apex sharing keywords and access modes under System.runAs: explicit USER_MODE DML on readable objects without the operation's grant, DML on records hidden by sharing, async sharing keywords, runAs governor counting, object-denial query shapes, stripInaccessible, runAs semantics, mode conflicts, inner classes and mixed-version inheritance, Pricebook2.
org: fresh scratch org from a campaign Dev Hub, Developer Edition, deleted after the run (delete verified). Org id, usernames, alias and host are not recorded.
capture date: 2026-11-16 (UTC). sf 2.157.8. Class source API 62.0, 66.0, 67.0 and 68.0 (class apiVersion of SamProbe<N> and its helpers), deployed at 68.0. SamPWo66/SamPOm66 are API 66.0; SamCOm67, SamCOm67b, SamCWo67, SamFmt and SamLog are API 67.0.
metadata: Sam_Obj__c (Private; Secret__c no grant, Open__c and None__c granted), Sam_RO__c (ReadWrite), Sam_None__c (no grant), Sam_Sh__c (Private), Sam_Log__c (audit log). Permission sets: Sam_Access (Standard User actor: Sam_Obj__c read/create/edit, Sam_RO__c read, Sam_Sh__c and Sam_Log__c full), Sam_RO_C (Sam_RO__c read and create), Sam_RO_E (Sam_RO__c read and edit), Sam_Admin (running administrator).
route: named @IsTest methods, one transaction each, one run of each class. Actors are created in the test: Standard User with Sam_Access, or Minimum Access - Salesforce for the Account rows.
observation: text after "=>" in the assertion message. "EX <type>: <message>" is a caught exception, followed by "| n= st= f=" for DmlException and "| inacc=" for QueryException. "ok" is success, "FAIL <code>:<message>:<fields>;" a failed Database result. Record ids are written as [ID]. "RAW <message>" is an uncaught failure.
Rows whose setup inserts Sam_Obj__c.Secret__c as the administrator at 67.0 and 68.0 fail in setup: the in-test Sam_Admin assignment does not grant the field (see sharing_access_follow f_adm_* rows).
